name: Johnny Mystery and The Halloween Killer
source:
On Halloween night, a young detective named Johnny Mystery comes across a girl trying to escape from the police.
Then, Johnny tries to unravel an intriguing murder case that happened during a party at the Municipal Music School.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323600/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
万圣节之夜，年轻侦探约翰尼·米斯特里遇见了一名试图躲避警方追捕的女孩。
随后，他开始调查一桩扑朔迷离的凶案，案件发生在市立音乐学校的一场派对上。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323600/]Steam[/url]]
